description: Plan lifecycle (T10): draft -> validated -> committed -> authorized -> revoked. One fresh registry per scenario; `at` is the clock of each step; `expect[i]` answers `steps[i]` (transition results, statuses, contexts). Roots are Merkle roots of the plan node leaves (planNodeLeaf), so a native must reproduce the commitment. `validator` is the server validator the registry is built with.
